Package index

Workflow verbs

The high-level interface: fit a learner, evaluate it, compare learners, tune, interpret and estimate contrasts from one formula and one dataset.

fit()
Fit a survival learner
predict(<survalis_fit>)
Predict from a fitted survival learner
evaluate()
Resampled performance of a survival learner
compare()
Compare several survival learners on shared resampling folds
tune()
Tune a survival learner over a hyperparameter grid
interpret()
Interpret a fitted survival learner
estimate()
Standardised causal-style contrast for a binary treatment
as.data.frame(<survalis_eval>) as.data.frame(<survalis_tune>) as.data.frame(<survalis_compare>) as.data.frame(<survalis_estimate>)
Tidy data frames from verb result objects
survalis survalis-package
survalis: Interpretable Survival Machine Learning

Resampling

Split schemes used by evaluate(), compare() and tune().

cv() holdout() group_cv() bootstrap()
Resampling specifications for evaluate(), tune() and compare()

Learners

Low-level fit and predict pairs, one per engine. Every predict_*() returns a survival matrix (rows are subjects, columns are times).

list_survlearners()
List survival learners available in survalis
summary(<mlsurv_model>)
Summarize an mlsurv_model
